Learning objectives: By the end of this webinar, participants will be able to: 1. Recognize the common and important causes of secondary hypertension in children. 2. Differentiate between cardiac, renal, and infectious etiologies based on clinical presentation and history. 3. Identify key clinical signs and symptoms that suggest an underlying cause of pediatric hypertension. 4. Outline a screening approach appropriate for general clinical practice to investigate secondary hypertension in children. 5. Know when to refer a child with hypertension to a specialist (pediatric cardiology, nephrology, or infectious diseases). Talk no 1: Introduction to paediatric hypertension and its possible underlying renal causes (Dr Vina Tressa) Talk no 2: Cardiovascular causes of hypertension in children (Dr Rumana Sangi) Talk no 3: Hypertension associated with Infectious diseases in children (Dr Ali Faisal) Question and answer plus concluding note (Dr. Saleem Akhar & Dr. Arshalooz Jamila Rehman)
